style: Tense, menacing 1980s sci-fi film synth battle score for a lonely retro pixel-art space game: a relentless dark synth-bass ostinato on a pedal tone, big gated-reverb toms and a gated snare from a drum machine, a tense low arpeggiator, minor-second synth stabs, low brass and cello swells, cold analog pads, tape echo and big reverb, rusted metallic percussion, a lonely cello line and heavy low toms. A fight among rusted copper relays at the edge of space. Urgent, dark and relentless, menacing, never heroic. Purely instrumental. Dm, 108 BPM.
